run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum difference between sums of any two rows in a matrix
test_f_gold: test f_gold with a matrix and dimensions to verify maximum row sum difference calculation
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use list comprehensions instead of nested loops for row sum computation
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds the maximum difference between row sums where the larger row appears after the smaller
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that tracks minimum row sum seen so far to find maximum difference
